riskAcceptances.rationale: Club branding deliberately keeps administrator-selected HTTPS logo URLs as a fallback for existing configurations. A same-origin upload is available and lets a club avoid the third-party request, but removing URL support would break those configurations.
riskAcceptances.compensatingControl: The policy grants only image loading over HTTPS; scripts, styles, connections, frames and forms remain same-origin, active URL schemes are rejected, the referrer policy limits cross-origin disclosure to the Courtside origin, and the administration surface offers a same-origin upload.
